# awscc_cloudwatch_resource_metrics_configuration (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::CloudWatch::ResourceMetricsConfiguration. Manages the detailed monitoring metric selections for an AWS resource, identified by the ARN of the resource being monitored.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the resource for which the detailed monitoring metrics configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `metric_selections` (Attributes List) The metric selections that define which metrics are enabled for detailed monitoring on the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric_selections))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time at which the resource metrics configuration was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) The time at which the resource metrics configuration was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--metric_selections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric_selections`

Optional:

- `include_metrics` (List of String) The list of metric names to include in detailed monitoring for the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cloudwatch_resource_metrics_configuration.example
  identity = {
    resource_arn = "resource_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `resource_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the resource for which the detailed monitoring metrics configuration is managed

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cloudwatch_resource_metrics_configuration.example
  id = "resource_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_cloudwatch_resource_metrics_configuration.example "resource_arn"
```
